title: arctostaphylos uva-ursi subsp. myrtifolia
intro: Arctostaphylos uva-ursi subsp. myrtifolia, commonly known as the red bearberry, is a plant species within the heath family (Ericaceae) that is native to North America. The health benefits of red bearberry include its potential to act as a diuretic, helping to alleviate urinary tract infections and other related issues. The plant is believed to exert therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which contribute to its potential use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents responsible for the plant's medicinal properties include arbutin, which has been identified as a key compound in its leaves.
